paragraphs: QLESS sells queue management software that lets an organization replace a physical line with a virtual one. Customers join a wait list from a phone or the web and get a notification when their turn comes. The platform also books appointments, sends reminders, and offers open slots to other customers after a cancellation.

Walk-ins, appointments, virtual visits and callbacks run through one system rather than separate tools. Managers watch throughput in real time, see where the backlog sits, and survey customers after a visit. Locations can be shut down or appointments redirected, with customers notified by SMS or email.

Qless describes the buyers as organizations across government, healthcare, higher education, retail and enterprise services. Ownership sits with Palisades Equity, a private investment firm. Security material on the site lists encryption of data in transit and at rest and role based access controls.

quote.text: From the public to the private sector, QLESS is the go-to solution for organizations looking to level up their customer operations
